농협중앙회는 농업인의 날인 11일 서울 서대문구 연세대에서 농업과 농촌의 가치를 알리고 청년들의 관심을 확대하기 위한 ‘농심천심(農心天心) 의 날’ 행사를 개최했다고 밝혔다. 행사에서는 국내 농축산물 시식과 제철 농산물 나눔, 청년 특화 금융상품 소개 등 다양한 프로그램이 진행됐다. 강호동 농협중앙회장은 이날 협동 조합론 특강을 진행하며 “농업의 발전을 위해서는 미래 세대인 청년들의 관심과 참여가 중요하다”고 당부했다.

The National Agricultural Cooperative Federation announced that on the 11th, Farmer's Day, it held an event called 'Nongshim Cheonsim (農心天心) Day' at Yonsei University in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul to promote the value of agriculture and rural areas and expand interest among young people. At the event, various programs were held, including sampling domestic agricultural and livestock products, sharing seasonal agricultural products, and introducing financial products specialized for youth. Kang Ho-dong, Chairman of the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation, gave a special lecture on cooperative theory and said, “For the development of agriculture, the interest and participation of young people, the future generation, is important.”

울산항만공사(사장 변재영·UPA)는 한국지능정보사회진흥원(NIA)으로부터 ‘인공지능(AI) 윤리 확인마크’(사진)를 발급받았다고 11일 밝혔다. ‘AI 윤리 확인마크’는 AI의 윤리적 개발과 활용을 촉진하고 공공·민간 부문의 책임성을 강화하기 위해 윤리 교육 이수 등 일정 요건을 충족한 기관에 부여된다. UPA는 최근 AI 기술 활용이 급격히 확대됨에 따라 발생할 수 있는 편향성과 차별, 개인정보 침해 등 윤리적 위험을 예방하고, 임직원의 책임감 있는 AI 활용 역량을 강화하기 위해 교육을 추진했다.

Ulsan Port Authority (CEO Byun Jae-young, UPA) announced on the 11th that it had received the ‘Artificial Intelligence (AI) Ethics Confirmation Mark’ (photo) from the Korea Intelligence and Information Society Agency (NIA). The ‘AI Ethics Confirmation Mark’ is granted to organizations that meet certain requirements, such as completion of ethics training, to promote the ethical development and use of AI and strengthen accountability in the public and private sectors. UPA promoted training to prevent ethical risks such as bias, discrimination, and personal information infringement that may arise as the use of AI technology has recently rapidly expanded, and to strengthen executives and employees' ability to use AI responsibly.

The Financial Security Institute, which manages information security for financial companies, suffered a hacking attack and approximately 650 pieces of personal information from 48 financial companies were leaked. As the possibility of information leakage was already pointed out in the audit of the attacked system four years ago, there is criticism that the response as a dedicated financial security agency was lax. According to the National Security Agency on the 11th, the continuous evaluation system that supports financial company security evaluations was attacked by hackers on the 9th, and about 130 files submitted to the National Security Agency by 48 financial companies were leaked. The leaked file included about 200 administrative forms, including samples of personal credit information consent forms, about 300 pieces of personal information such as name and date of birth included in the administrative forms, and about 350 pieces of system user information.

A woman in her 20s who stole a necklace and other items from a luxury department store in Busan was caught in a joint operation between police and taxi drivers. The police who received the report contacted the taxi driver and asked him to go to a nearby police station.

농협중앙회는 11일 서울 서대문구 연세대학교에서 농업인의 날을 맞아 ‘농심천심의 날’ 행사를 개최했다고 밝혔다.이날 강호동 농협중앙회장은 대학생들을 대상으로 협동조합론 특강을 진행했다. 강 회장은 농업·농촌의 가치와 협동조합의 역할을 설명하고 청년들에게 농업의 지속가능한 발전을 위한 관심과 참여를 당부했다.행사장에서는 우리 농축산물 시식과 제철 농산물 나눔, 청년 금융상품 소개 등 체험 프로그램도 운영됐다.농협경제지주는 ‘행복米밥차’를 통해 학생들에게 주먹밥을 제공하고 안심한우 불고기 시식 행사와 목우촌 가공식품 홍보를 진행했다고 전했다.

On the 11th, the Nonghyup Central Committee held the 'Nongsimcheon Heart Day‘ event for Farmers’ Day at Yonsei University in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul. On that day, Kang Ho-dong, Chairman of the Nonghyup Central Committee, gave a special lecture on cooperative theory for university students. Kang explained the values of agriculture and rural communities and the role of cooperatives, and asked young people to be interested and involved in sustainable development of agriculture. At the venue, there was also an experience program such as tasting of Woori agricultural and livestock products, sharing of seasonal agricultural products, and introducing youth financial products. Nonghyup Economic Group reported that it provided rice balls to students through ‘Happy Rice Tea', held safe beef bulgogi tasting events, and promoted processed foods in Mokwoo Village.

[Full-time agricultural newspaper = Reporter Kim Jin-seop] Jeju Special Self-Governing Province Agricultural Research and Extension Services (hereinafter referred to as Jeju Agricultural Research and Extension Services)'s ‘Data down to the lot, policies customized: Transition to artificial intelligence (AI)-based tweezer agricultural administration’ received an excellence award as an example of ‘transition to artificial intelligence (AI)-based tweezer agricultural administration’ at the ‘2026 Agricultural and Food Statistical Data + Artificial Intelligence (AI) Analysis and Utilization Contest’ awards ceremony. Jeju was selected this time. The Agricultural Research and Development Institute's best practice was to use artificial intelligence (AI) to precisely analyze agricultural data on a parcel-by-lot basis and lay the foundation for customized agricultural policies. GC녹십자, 협력사 50여곳과 공급망 ESG 관리 강화GC Green Cross strengthens supply chain ESG management with more than 50 partners

GC녹십자는 지난 10일 수원컨벤션센터에서 주요 협력사와 상생협력 강화를 위한 ‘2026 GC녹십자 동반성장 파트너스 데이(Partner’s Day)’를 개최했다고 11일 밝혔다.올해로 7회째를 맞은 행사에는 원료와 부자재, 장비 등을 공급하는 주요 협력사 50여 곳의 대표 및 임직원 약 90명이 참석했다.GC녹십자는 이번 행사에서 새롭게 수립한 지속가능한 공급망 관리 운영규정을 소개하고 환경·사회·지배구조(ESG) 정책을 공유했다.특히 윤리·인권·환경·안전보건 분야의 협력사 행동규범과 이행 여부를 점검하기 위한 평가·실사 체계를 안내했다.

GC Green Cross held ‘2026 GC Green Cross Partner's Day‘ at Suwon Convention Center on the 10th to strengthen win-win cooperation with major partners, it said on the 11th. About 90 representatives and employees from 50 major suppliers supplying raw materials, subsidiary materials, and equipment attended this year's seventh event.GC Green Cross introduced the newly established sustainable supply chain management operating regulations and shared environmental, social, and governance (ESG) policies at the event. In particular, he guided the evaluation and due diligence system to check the conduct and implementation of the Code of Conduct of partners in the field of ethics, human rights, environment, and safety and health.

머리 빗으며 탈모 치료?…생쥐 실험서 발모 효과 보인 ‘전기 빗’ [건강팩트체크]Hair brushing and hair loss treatment? … ‘Electric comb‘ showing hair loss effect in mouse lab [Health Fact Check]

탈모 치료의 새로운 가능성을 보여주는 ‘전기 빗’이 개발됐다. 빗질하는 동안 모낭에 전기 자극을 가하는 동시에 발모를 촉진하고 탈모를 억제하는 치료 물질을 전달하는 장치다.유전적 소인과 남성 호르몬인 안드로겐의 영향으로 모발이 점차 가늘어지고 빠지는 안드로겐성 탈모는 가장 흔한 유형의 탈모로 전 세계 15억 명에게 영향을 미치는 것으로 추산된다. 탈모를 겪는 많은 남녀는 심리적 부담과 삶의 질 저하를 경험한다.

An ‘electric comb‘ has been developed that shows the new possibilities of hair loss treatment. It is a device that delivers a therapeutic substance that promotes hair loss and inhibits hair loss while applying electrical stimulation to the hair follicles during combing. Androgenic hair loss, which is gradually thinning and falling out due to the influence of genetic predisposition and androgen, a male hormone, is the most common type of hair loss and is estimated to affect 1.5 billion people worldwide. Many men and women who suffer from hair loss experience a psychological burden and decreased quality of life.

다시찾는 중장년의 역할-‘중장년네트워크컴투게더’ 출범Revisiting the Role of Middle Age - Launched ‘Middle Age Network Together’

“퇴직 후의 소득과 일자리도 중요하지만 누구와 새로운 관계를 맺고 자신의 경험을 어디에 쓸 것인지도 중요하다.”중장년층이 자신의 경험과 지식을 활용해 은퇴 이후에도 사회 속에서 새로운 역할과 삶의 의미을 찾고, 새로운 관계를 맺어가기 위한 모임인 ‘중장년네트워크컴투게더(이하 컴투게더)’가 11일 서울 마포구 강북노동자복지관에서 창립총회를 열고 출범했다. 전국에서 약 120여명의 창립동행인이 참석한 이날 총회에서 정광필(서울50플러스인생학교 학장), 김수동(돌봄주거활동가), 정선애( 9월아침 이사)씨가 공동대표로 선임됐다.

“Income and jobs after retirement are important, but so are who you form new relationships with and where you spend your experience.” ‘Middle-aged Network Together', a group for middle-aged people to use their experiences and knowledge to find new roles and meanings of life in society even after retirement, and to form new relationships, opened and launched the founding general meeting on November 11 at the Gangbuk Workers’ Welfare Center in Mapo-gu, Seoul. At the general meeting attended by about 120 founding companions from all over the country, Jeong Kwang-pil (Dean of Seoul 50 Plus In-School), Kim Soo-dong (Care Residential Activist), and Jeong Seon-ae (Director on September morning) were appointed as co-chairs.

Ulsan Port Authority (UPA, President Byun Jae-young) announced on the 11th that it had been issued the ‘Artificial Intelligence Ethics Confirmation Mark’ by the Korea Intelligence and Information Society Agency (NIA). UPA is designed to protect against bias, discrimination, and bias that may occur as the use of artificial intelligence technology has recently rapidly expanded. Training was promoted to prevent ethical risks such as personal information infringement and to strengthen executives and employees' ability to use artificial intelligence responsibly. 내일 아침 ‘영하 2도’ 쌀쌀…오후 흐리고 미세먼지 ‘나쁨’Tomorrow morning ‘minus 2 degrees’ chilly... afternoon cloudy and fine dust ‘bad’

목요일인 12일은 아침 최저 영하 2도까지 떨어져 쌀쌀하겠다. 오후부터 서쪽 지역이 차차 흐려지고, 서울 등 일부 지역은 미세먼지가 ‘나쁨’ 수준을 보이겠다.기상청은 “내일 아침 기온이 낮아 춥겠고, 전국 내륙에서 서리가 내리는 곳이 있겠다”며 “전국이 가끔 구름이 많다가 오후에 서쪽 지역부터 차차 흐려지겠다”고 11일 예보했다.하늘은 제주도 남쪽 해상에 위치한 고기압의 영향으로 가끔 구름이 많겠다.

Thursday, the 12th, will be chilly with a minimum of minus 2 degrees in the morning. From the afternoon, the western regions will gradually become blurred, and some regions, such as Seoul, will show ‘poor’ levels of fine dust. The Korea Meteorological Administration predicted on the 11th that "the temperature will be cold tomorrow morning, and there will be frosts in the interior of the country," and that "the country will be cloudy sometimes, but gradually cloudy from the western region in the afternoon." The sky is sometimes cloudy due to the influence of high atmospheric pressure located in the southern sea of Jeju Island.

Local governments are recruiting outside investigative experts from the police or lawyers to the Special Judicial Police (Special Envoy) organization. This is due to the enforcement of the new Criminal Procedure Act, which prevents the envoy from being directed by the prosecutor. 이마트가 트레이더스 등 본업 경쟁력 강화에 힘입어 올해 3분기 외형 성장과 수익성 개선을 동시에 이뤘다. 별도 기준 총매출은 분기 처음으로 5조 원을 넘어섰고 영업이익도 40% 넘게 늘었다. 다만 스타벅스를 운영하는 SCK컴퍼니의 실적 부진으로 연결 기준 영업이익은 전년 동기 대비 큰 폭으로 감소했다.이마트는 올해 3분기 별도 기준 총매출이 5조1040억 원으로 전년 동기 대비 11.1% 증가했다고 11일 공시했다.

E-Mart achieved both top-line growth and improved profitability in the third quarter of this year thanks to strengthening the competitiveness of its main business, including Traders. Total sales on a separate basis exceeded 5 trillion won for the first time in a quarter, and operating profit also increased by more than 40%. However, due to poor performance of SCK Company, which operates Starbucks, operating profit on a consolidated basis decreased significantly compared to the same period last year. E-Mart announced on the 11th that total sales on a separate basis in the third quarter of this year were KRW 5.104 trillion, an 11.1% increase compared to the same period last year.

49년째 비행중인 보이저 1호, 인류 최초 ‘1광일’ 거리 도달Voyager 1, in its 49th year of flight, reaches mankind's first ‘1-light-day’ distance

지구에서 보낸 신호가 도착하는 데만 꼬박 하루가 걸리는 곳에 인류의 우주탐사선이 도달한다. 1977년 발사된 미국의 무인 우주탐사선 보이저 1호가 49년간의 비행 끝에 인류가 만든 물체 중 처음으로 지구에서 ‘1광일(光日)’ 떨어진 곳에 이른다.미국 항공우주국(NASA)은 10일(현지 시간) 보이저 1호가 18일 오전 5시 16분경(미 동부 시간) 지구에서 약 259억 km 떨어진 곳에 도달한다고 밝혔다. 이는 지구와 태양 사이 거리의 약 173배로, 초속 약 30만 km인 빛조차 하루가 꼬박 걸려야 도착하는 거리다.

Humanity's space probe arrives at a place where it takes a full day for a signal from Earth to arrive. After 49 years of flight, the American unmanned space probe Voyager 1, launched in 1977, became the first human-made object to reach a distance of '1 light day' from Earth. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) announced on the 10th (local time) that Voyager 1 will reach a distance of about 25.9 billion km from Earth at around 5:16 a.m. on the 18th (US Eastern Time). This is about 173 times the distance between the Earth and the Sun, a distance that even light traveling at about 300,000 km per second takes a full day to reach.

SFMOMA는 미국 서부 최초의 현대미술관이자 주요 현대미술관 중 하나다.전시에 참여한 학생들은 현지 고등학교 한국어반 학생과 주말 한글학교 고등학생으로, 모두 미술 전공자가 아닌 일반 학생이다.

Twenty-four artworks by local high school students studying Korean will be displayed at the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art (SFMOMA) in California, USA. According to the Ministry of Education, an exhibition of student works under the theme of ‘Hangul Beyond Boundaries’ will be held in the SFMOMA common space from the 12th of this month to April 20th of next year. This exhibition was created in collaboration between the San Francisco Korean Education Center under the Ministry of Education and SFMOMA. SFMOMA is the first modern art museum in the western United States and one of the major contemporary art museums. The students who participated in the exhibition were students from a local high school Korean language class and high school students from a weekend Korean language school, and all of them are general students, not art majors.

“그대들의 발자취는 에티오피아의 자부심이었고 그대들의 희생은 대한민국의 자유가 되었다.”6·25전쟁에 참전해 전사한 에티오피아 장병 122명을 기리는 ‘추모의 벽’이 에티오피아에 건립됐다. 추모의 벽에는 에티오피아를 상징하는 사자와 진군하는 강뉴부대원을 새긴 동판, 전사자 122명의 명패가 설치됐다. 추모 문구는 한글과 영어, 에티오피아 공용어인 암하라어로 새겨졌다.국가보훈부에 따르면 11일(현지 시간) 아디스아바바 성 트리니티 대성당에서 보훈부와 HD건설기계가 함께 조성한 ‘에티오피아 전사자 추모의 벽’ 제막식이 열렸다.

“Your footsteps were the pride of Ethiopia, and your sacrifice became the freedom of the Republic of Korea.” In Ethiopia, a 'memorial wall‘ was erected to honor the 122 Ethiopian soldiers who died in the June 25 war. On the wall of remembrance, a lion symbolizing Ethiopia, a copper plaque engraving the advancing Gangneu troops, and a plaque of 122 fallen soldiers were installed. The memorial phrase was engraved in Korean, English, and Amharic, the official language of Ethiopia. According to the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, the "Wall of Remembrance for Ethiopian Warriors", which was created by the Ministry of Veterans Affairs and HD Construction Machines, was held at Addis Ababa St. Trinity Cathedral on the 11th (local time).

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk of People's Power refuted the allegations by People's Power Hwang Kyung-sung that the discipline against independent Representative Han Dong-hoon and People's Power Jin Jong-oh had been tampered with on November 11, saying, "If you are going to argue that there is a procedural problem, you can take legal action." 엔비디아·AMD 등 칩 설계 기업과 삼성전자·SK하이닉스·마이크론 등 메모리 기업에 이어 글로벌 파운드리(반도체 위탁생산) 1위 대만 TSMC까지 오픈AI·앤스로픽 등 인공지능(AI) 개발사 지분 투자에 나섰다. AI 개발사들의 몸값 눈높이가 낮아지자 반도체 공급망 전체가 ‘큰손 고객’ 살리기에 뛰어든 모양새다. 다만 투자금이 칩 구매 대금으로 되돌아오는 ‘순환거래’ 의혹은 끊이지 않고 있다.10일(현지 시간) 외신에 따르면 TSMC는 이날 이사회를 열고 오픈AI 우선주와 앤스로픽 보통주를 각각 최대 5억 달러(약 6670억 원)어치를 사들이는 안건을 승인했다.

Following chip design companies such as NVIDIA and AMD, memory companies such as Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Micron, and Taiwan TSMC, which is the No. 1 global foundry (semiconductor consignment production), invested in equity in artificial intelligence (AI) developers such as OpenAI and Anthropic. As the ransom price eye level of AI developers decreased, the entire semiconductor supply chain seems to have jumped in to save ’big-handed customers’. However, there are constant allegations of 'circulation transactions‘ in which the investment funds are returned to the purchase price of chips. According to foreign sources on the 10th (local time), TSMC held a board meeting on the same day and approved an agenda to buy up to $500 million (approximately KRW 667 billion) each of OpenAI Preferred Stock and Anthropic Common Stock.

전국민주노동조합총연맹 전국철도노동조합(철도노조)이 승진제도 개선과 안전인력 충원 등을 요구하며 다음 달 10일 오전 9시부터 무기한 총파업에 나서겠다고 예고했다. 코레일은 협상을 이어가되 파업 시 대체인력을 투입해 열차 운행률을 높일 방침이다.철도노조는 11일 서울역 광장에서 기자회견을 열고 요구사항이 받아들여지지 않으면 총파업에 돌입하겠다고 밝혔다. 노조는 본사·본부 직원과 관리자에게 승진 기회가 쏠리고 있다며 현장 노동자에게도 공정한 기회를 보장하라고 요구했다.

The National Railway Workers' Union (railway union) of the National Democratic Union of Korea announced that it will go on a general strike indefinitely from 9:00 am on the 10th of next month, demanding improvements to the promotion system and the addition of safety personnel. Korail plans to continue negotiations but increase the train operation rate by adding alternative personnel in the event of a strike. The railway union held a press conference in Seoul Station Plaza on the 11th and said that it would go on a general strike if the requirements were not accepted. The union said that promotion opportunities are being attracted to headquarters and headquarters employees and managers, and demanded that field workers be guaranteed a fair opportunity.

Samsung Electronics received the best (S) rating in the 2026 Shared Growth Index evaluation selected by the Shared Growth Commission, and Samsung Electronics is the only company to receive the S rating for 15 consecutive years after introducing the assessment in 2011. The police caught an insurance sales organization that let corporate representatives buy insurance with cash and returned a total of 73.2 billion won to each representative in return. On November 11, the Metropolitan Crime Investigation Unit of the Seoul Police Agency detained the 30-year-old man who was the general manager and transferred 231 members, corporate representatives, and lenders for violations of the Insurance Business Act, imprisonment, and assistant cell withdrawal under certain criminal aggravated laws. According to the police, they operated an insurance agency branch from 2021 to December 2024 and recommended 505 representatives of the corporation to purchase “term life insurance”, a life insurance product.

A car rushed into a beauty salon on the first floor of a shopping mall in Eupha-ri, Hoengseong-eup, Hoengseong-gun, Gangwon-do. According to the Gangwon-do Fire Department on the 11th, a total of three people, including two female customers and a female business owner in her 50s, were injured in the accident that occurred around 2:05 p.m. One of the two guests was found to be in cardiac arrest, and the other was seriously injured. The salon owner was found to have minor injuries. The fire department was called to the scene and completed the rescue of the three people at about 2:38 p.m. Police and fire departments are investigating the exact accident and the damage.

친구를 많이 사귀기보다 가까운 몇 명과 지내는 것을 선호하고, 스트레스를 주는 사람과는 관계를 정리하는 성인이 늘고 있는 것으로 나타났다.시장조사 전문기업 엠브레인 트렌드모니터가 전국 만 19~59세 성인 남녀 1000명을 대상으로 조사한 결과, 응답자의 76.8%는 ‘피로감이나 스트레스를 주는 사람과 관계를 끊거나 거리를 둔 경험이 있다’고 답했다. 이 비율은 40대에서 81.2%로 가장 높았으며 여성도 79.6%로 전체 평균을 웃돌았다.사람들과 거리를 둔 이유로는 ‘만난 뒤 기분이 나빠지거나 기운이 빠졌다’는 응답이 46.0%로 가장 많았다.

It has been found that more adults prefer to spend time with a few close friends rather than making a lot of friends, and that more adults are organizing their relationships with people who are stressed. As a result of a survey of 1,000 men and women aged 19 to 59 nationwide by Embrain Trend Monitor, a market research company, 76.8% of the respondents said that they had experienced ‘disconnection or distancing from a person who causes fatigue or stress’. This rate was the highest at 81.2% from the 40s, and women were also above the overall average at 79.6%. The most common reason for distancing from people was 46.0%, who said they felt bad or lost energy after meeting.

Sangmi Dang Holdings expanded its food delivery support by donating two additional frozen tower cars to the food bank. The intention is to help local food banks who have difficulty shipping old vehicles. Sangmi Dang Holdings said on the 11th that the Happy Foundation, a social welfare corporation affiliated with the Korean Social Welfare Council, delivered two frozen tower cars and 4,000 loaves of bread to the National Food Bank on the 10th. The Happy Foundation has donated a total of 12 vehicles since 2022, and aims to donate a total of 20 vehicles by 2030. Sangmi Dang Holdings has been donating food since 1998, when the food bank began, along with Paris Croissant and Paris Baguette.

충남 서천군 한솔제지 장항공장에서 30대 근로자가 대형 종이롤에 끼여 숨졌다.11일 경찰과 소방 당국 등에 따르면 전날 오후 7시 20분경 서천 장항읍 한솔제지 장항공장 감열동 슬리터 공정에서 협력업체 소속 근로자가 작업 중 종이롤에 끼였다.이 사고로 30대 근로자는 크게 다쳐 병원에 옮겨져 치료를 받던 중 결국 숨졌다.사고 당시 피해자는 지게차로 종이롤을 옮기던 중 롤이 떨어져 굴러가자 이를 막으려다 철문과 롤 사이에 끼인 것으로 파악됐다.경찰은 현재 공장 관계자 등을 상대로 안전수칙 준수 여부 등 정확한 사고 경위를 조사 중이다.

A worker in his 30s was caught in a large paper roll at Janghang Factory in Hansol, Seocheon-gun, Chungcheongnam-do.According to the police and fire authorities, a worker belonging to a contractor was stuck in a paper roll while working at the thermal field slitter process at Janghang Factory in Hansol, Janghang-eup, Seochon, Chungcheongnam-do around 7:20 p.m. on the previous day. In this accident, a worker in his 30s was seriously injured and was taken to a hospital for treatment, where he eventually died. At the time of the accident, the victim was found to have been stuck between the iron gate and the roll when the roll fell and rolled while moving the paper roll with the forklift. Police are currently investigating the exact accident, including compliance with safety rules, against factory officials.

크리스마스를 앞두고 새로운 인연을 찾는 미혼남녀를 위한 만남의 자리가 서울 동대문디자인플라자(DDP)에서 열린다. 서울시는 올해 마지막 ‘서울팅’ 행사에 참여할 미혼남녀 150명을 모집한다.11일 서울시에 따르면 올해 마지막 서울팅인 ‘설렘 in 서울, DDP편’은 다음 달 12일 DDP 디자인랩 4층 잔디사랑방에서 개최된다.서울팅은 서울시가 미혼남녀에게 자연스러운 만남의 기회를 제공하기 위해 마련한 프로그램이다. 2024년 11월 첫 행사 이후 누적 신청자만 1만 7672명에 달하고, 지금까지 179쌍의 커플이 탄생했다.

A meeting place for single men and women looking for a new relationship before Christmas will be held at the Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP) in Seoul. Seoul is recruiting 150 single men and women to participate in the last ‘Seoul Ting’ event this year.According to the Seoul Metropolitan Government on the 11th, the last Seoul Ting ‘Sulem in Seoul, DDP Flight’ will be held on the 12th of next month in the Lawn Love Room on the 4th floor of the DDP Design Lab. Seoul Ting is a program designed by the Seoul Metropolitan Government to provide natural meeting opportunities for single men and women. Since the first event in November 2024, there have been 17,672 cumulative applicants, and 179 couples have been born.

더불어민주당 김민석 대표가 11일 윤석열 전 대통령의 12·3 비상계엄 선포에 관여한 혐의를 받는 한덕수 전 국무총리의 20일 석방 가능성에 대해 “국민을 대상으로 내란 세력 부활의 선전포고를 하는 것으로 볼 수밖에 없다”고 비판했다. 또 “조희대 사법부의 정치 개입과 사법 농단을 단호하게 바로잡겠다”며 조희대 대법원장을 규탄했다. 김 대표는 이날 전남광주통합특별시의회에서 열린 민주당 최고위원회의에서 “대법원이 힘을 모아 내란범을 풀어주겠다는 것인가”라며 “한덕수 석방은 대법원이 국민의 인내와 절제의 마지노선을 짓밟은 것”이라며 이같이 밝혔다.

On the 11th, Kim Min-seok, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, criticized the possibility of the release on the 20th of former Prime Minister Han Deok-soo, who is suspected of being involved in former President Yoon Seok-yeol's declaration of martial law on December 3, saying, "It can only be seen as a declaration of war for the revival of insurgent forces targeting the people." He also criticized Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, saying, “We will firmly correct the political intervention and judicial corruption of the judiciary.” Representative Kim said this at the Democratic Party Supreme Committee meeting held at the Gwangju Unified Special City Council in Jeollanam-do on this day, saying, “Is the Supreme Court going to join forces to release the insurrectionist?” and “The release of Han Deok-soo is the Supreme Court trampling on the Maginot Line of people’s patience and restraint.”

한국과 우크라이나 외교장관이 10일(현지 시간) 프랑스 파리에서 7개국(G7) 외교장관회의를 계기로 대면 회담을 가졌다. 양국 장관이 직접 만난 것은 북한군 포로의 한국행 이후 벌어진 양국 간 공개 갈등 이후 처음이다. 11일 외교부에 따르면 이날 회담에서 조현 외교부 장관은 국가 간 상호 존중과 신뢰와 성실한 합의 이행은 양국 관계 발전을 위한 기본 전제조건임을 강조하면서, 양국 간 제반 현안이 원만히 해결되기를 바란다고 말했다.

The foreign ministers of Korea and Ukraine held a face-to-face meeting at the G7 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Paris, France on the 10th (local time). This is the first time that the ministers of the two countries have met in person since the open conflict between the two countries that broke out after North Korean prisoners of war were sent to South Korea. According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the 11th, at the meeting, Minister of Foreign Affairs Cho Hyun emphasized that mutual respect and trust between countries and faithful implementation of agreements are basic prerequisites for the development of relations between the two countries, and expressed hope that all pending issues between the two countries will be resolved amicably.

이재명 대통령이 10일 재개발 구역 ‘알박기’를 거론하면서 전국의 불법행위 방치 실태를 전수 조사하라고 지시했다. 단순 계도 차원을 넘어 범정부 차원의 강력한 수사와 처벌을 통해 부동산 불법행위를 근절해야 한다는 의지를 드러낸 것. 법 집행을 무력화하고 이익을 얻는 관행을 바로잡아 법치주의를 확립하겠다는 국정 기조를 재차 강조한 것으로 풀이된다.

A motion to extend the deployment of the Cheonghae Unit, which would approximately double the operational area of ​​the Cheonghae Unit from the Gulf of Aden to the open seas of southern Oman and increase mine removal capabilities, passed the Cabinet meeting on the 10th and was submitted to the National Assembly. It was confirmed that two redevelopment apartment occupancy rights were available in front of the land owned by Kim Jong-cheol, a candidate for National Police Agency Commissioner General, and his wife in Sangdaewon District 2, Jungwon-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi-do. 올해 9월19일 제76주년 서울수복 기념행사를 앞둔 1주일 전. 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관 겸 한미연합군사령관이 오세훈 서울시장 측에 기념행사 종료 후 비공개 환담을 요청했다. 미군 용산기지 반환에 한미 정부가 공식 합의한 후 22년 동안 전임 서울시장이 2017년 미군을 상대로 용산 반환 논의를 요청한 적이 있지만, 그 반대 경우는 처음이다.

One week before the 76th anniversary of the restoration of Seoul on September 19th of this year. Xavier Brunson, commander of U.S. Forces Korea and commander of the ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command, requested a private meeting with Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon after the commemorative event. In the 22 years since the Korean and U.S. governments officially agreed to return the U.S. Yongsan Garrison, the former mayor of Seoul requested the U.S. military to discuss the return of Yongsan in 2017, but this is the first time the reverse has occurred.
